home.label: 👤  Who are you?
home.answer: I'm Zakaria Chamekh, a passionate Full Stack web developer based in Casablanca. I specialize in building modern, responsive web applications with a strong focus on performance and immersive UI/UX. 🚀

home.label: 🛠️  What services do you offer?
home.answer:
I offer a full range of digital services:
• Web Development — React, Laravel, WordPress
• API design & backend architecture
• UI/UX design & prototyping (Figma)
• 3D / WebGL interactive experiences

Let's build something amazing together! 💡

home.label: ⚡  What technologies do you use?
home.answer:
🧰 My tech stack includes:

Front‑End: React · Three.js · GSAP · Tailwind
Back‑End: Laravel · PHP · MySQL · Node.js
Tools: Figma · Git · Postman · WordPress

Always learning, always growing! 📚

home.label: 🎨  Show me your projects
home.answer:
Sure! Here are some highlights:

🎮 La Casa De Papel Game — interactive quiz game
🛒 05‑Electro — e‑commerce (React + Laravel)

☁️ 05 Météo — weather app with live API
📚 Bibliotique — library management platform

Scroll up to the Projects section to see them live! ⬆️

home.label: 📬  How can I contact you?
home.answer:
I'd love to hear from you! 😊

📧 Email: Use the contact form above
💼 LinkedIn: Connect with me professionally
🐙 GitHub: Check out my code

Don't hesitate — let's create something great together! ✨

services.label: 💻  Web Development?
services.answer: That's my core craft. I build hyper-modern custom applications with React on the front and Laravel on the back. The architecture is ultra-fast (SSR/CSR) and fully secure.

services.label: 🧊  3D & WebGL experiences?
services.answer: Thanks to Three.js and GSAP, I bring web design to life. Sites are no longer simple 2D pages — they become real interactive virtual experiences (like my portfolio).

services.label: 🛒  E-commerce stores?
services.answer: I design turnkey stores (WordPress/WooCommerce or React/Laravel), built to generate sales. Including online payment, admin panel and delivery management.

services.label: 🚀  How about SEO?
services.answer: My code is optimized for search engines (Google). Semantic structure, lightning-fast load times, and dynamic tags. Everything is ready to put you on the 1st page.

services.label: 📬  How to start a project?
services.answer: It's very simple! 🚀 Use the huge email link at the end of the page or write to me directly at zakariach05@gmail.com to discuss it.
